AI Analyst View
FY2027 rev guide $400M–$460M

Russell 3000/2000 add Sep 21
Triggers passive buying from index trackers; can create near-term inflows and liquidity.
Orders for 13 machines due Nov
Execution on deliveries is needed to scale capacity; delays would risk guidance.
Capacity aim ~1,000T to ~10,000T

DFARS ban starts Jan 1, 2027

Tier-1 OEM quality certification
